actions.summary: Sends 14,450,000 MNDE from DAO MNDE account H988…Mo6u to DAO MNDE account G5Ax…eY2v (both DAO-owned).

findings.title: Moves 14.4M MNDE between DAO accounts
findings.explanation: DAO MNDE account G5Ax…eY2v is controlled by this DAO, so funds stay inside the DAO.

description.text: Send back 14,450,000 MNDE to DAO treasury out of the 26,000,000 MNDE market making budget voted in June 2024 (https://forum.marinade.finance/t/dao-proposal-unlock-a-26m-mnde-budget-to-onboard-multiple-market-makers-for-mnde/1393/4).

notes: Some instructions already executed: treasury shares were computed against reconstructed pre-execution balances (current balance + executed amounts), which is approximate.
